note: PROPERTIES THAT HAVE CLOSED OR CHANGED NAME, keyed by the slug in src/data/hotels.json. That file is generated from the sheet and carries no status field, so nothing stopped the site linking a hotel that had shut - kings-cross-area-guide was live with a 'Check prices' link to a hostel closed until 2027. Both link paths now read this file: remark-hotel-links.mjs refuses to emit an affiliate link for anything listed with closed:true, and AreaHotels.astro replaces its booking link with the closure note.
howToUse: Add a slug with `closed: true` to stop every link to it site-wide. Entries without `closed` are recorded corrections only - they do not block links, they are here so the sheet edit is a copy-out job. THIS FILE IS THE FAST STOP, NOT THE RECORD: src/data/hotels.json is generated by scripts/export-hotels.mjs from the Google Sheet, so the sheet must be corrected too or the next export reinstates the bad data. Delete an entry once the sheet catches up, or when a closed property reopens.
verifiedBy: Each entry checked against the operator's own site on the date shown. The four domain claims were re-checked 2026-09-08: themegarohotel.co.uk returns no DNS at all; themegarocollection.com, pointahotels.com/our-hotels/kings-cross/ and kabannas.com/en/london-st-pancras all return 200.

clink78.what: Clink 78 is closed. Its own site: 'Clink 78 is closed for now. Not forever - we will be reopening in 2027 with a new look.' Under renovation, no confirmed reopening date, not accepting bookings. Clink's own replacement is Clink 261.
clink78.sheetAction: Mark closed/withdrawn so no page can link it.
clink78.foundBy: The King's Cross where-to-stay pass. It was the only King's Cross property with an affiliateUrl, and kings-cross-area-guide was rendering a live paid link to it.

replacement.name: Clink 261
replacement.detail: Pod beds with privacy screens. Mixed dorms sleeping 1-18, female-only dorms 4-10, twin and private rooms to 6. Self-catering kitchen, bar, cafe. Check-in 4pm, check-out 10am. Booking direct saves 15%.
replacement.sheetAction: Consider adding as a new record - it is the open Clink in King's Cross and currently has no row.

yha-london-st-pancras.what: Left the YHA network. yha.org.uk: the hostel 'has left the YHA network. It will remain part of the hostelling movement under a new operator.' Same building, 79-81 Euston Road, NW1 2QE.
yha-london-st-pancras.sheetAction: name, brand ('yha'), chainType, website, whyGo ('run by a charity') and opNote are all wrong. typicalFrom 'About £30 a bed' is wrong - rates are graded, not per bed.
yha-london-st-pancras.rates: Pod from £50, Cabin from £60, Nest from £130 (private en-suite, air conditioned). Tribe room sleeping 4-6 listed as coming.
yha-london-st-pancras.roomTypes: Pods (a private berth in a shared room, no lockable door of its own; laptop locker inside plus luggage locker outside; no food or drink allowed in pod rooms), cabins (own door, digital key), nests, tribe.
yha-london-st-pancras.detail: Female-only pod rooms. Open 24 hours. Check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00. Ground-floor 'The Commons' cafe and natural wine bar.

st-pancras-renaissance.what: Rebranded on 3 June 2025 - its own site says it 'gracefully rebranded as St Pancras London, Autograph Collection'. Same building, the Midland Grand.
st-pancras-renaissance.sheetAction: name and flag are stale. Marriott is still right at group level; the flag is Autograph Collection. Room count should read 207 bedrooms plus 36 signature suites. Website should be https://stpancraslondon.com/ rather than the marriott.com deep link, which sits behind bot protection.
